module "D_DifferentArguments.dss"

product 0 Material "M_DifferentArguments" backend=Graph
  %0 = TextureParameter(ParameterName="Tex", SortPriority=0) : Texture2D @L2:C1 "Tex"
  %1 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L6:C27 "A"
  %2 = TextureSample(%0, %1, _, _) : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L6:C16 "A"
  %3 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=1) : float2 @L7:C27 "B"
  %4 = TextureSample(%0, %3, _, _) : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L7:C16 "B"
  %5 = Swizzle(%2, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L8:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %6 = Swizzle(%4, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L8:C31 "EmissiveColor"
  %7 = Add(%5, %6) : float3 @L8:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %8 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%7) @L4:C1
  sink %8
